todo.text:
Quizlet: practise the "Let's get nails done" flashcards
https://quizlet.com/ua/1165325421/a2-b1-lets-get-nails-done-flash-cards/?i=45ddyf&x=1jqY
Write ten sentences with words from the lesson about nails. Look through the word cloud and practise making sentences using vocabulary from the lesson.
Learn the 7 new Black Friday words in Flashcards below
Pronunciation: practise "article" /ˈɑːtɪkl/ and "chosen" /ˈtʃəʊzn/. Listen, repeat, and record yourself

flashcards.example: I'm trying to cut back on online shopping this month.
She splurged on a new coat in the Black Friday sale.
Prices go up and down because of supply and demand.
Big retailers start their sales a week before Black Friday.
E-commerce has grown very fast in the last few years.
We splashed out on a new TV this year.
I picked up a real bargain: winter boots for half price.
I get a manicure every three weeks.
Gel polish lasts much longer than normal nail polish.
She used a nail file to shape her nails.
The manicurist gently pushed back my cuticles.
Can I see the colour chart, please?
She got long nail extensions for the party.
I prefer natural nails. They're healthier.
Gel polish dries under a UV lamp.
Use a buffer to make your nails smooth and shiny.
File the edge of the nail gently.
Stiletto nails are long and very pointed.
Squoval nails are square with soft, rounded corners.
Oval nails make your fingers look longer.
Coffin nails are long with a flat, square tip.
Short round nails are easy to look after.
Mountain peak nails have a sharp tip, like the top of a mountain.
Square nails have straight sides and a flat edge.
Almond nails are oval with a slightly pointed tip.

topics.title: Black Friday: shopping and money vocabulary
Let's get nails done
topics.note:
